description: Cancel one of your bounties by ID with a reason (add details when the reason is other). Full refund: cancelled right away; add preview: true to get it held as confirmation_required first. Partial or no refund: returns confirmation_required with the refund for each spot, startsAt (the start time the refund uses, or null), a confirmationToken and an idempotencyKey; call again with only that confirmationToken and idempotencyKey within 5 minutes to cancel. A hired human hasn't finished: returns 409 cancellation_blocked; open a dispute instead. Every reply, including a $0 refund, lists each spot (refundAmount, workerPayment, serviceFee), bonusRefundAmount (unearned bonus money returned), poolRefundAmount (money for spots no human filled) and totalRefundAmount, in cents. The reason stays private.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty

confirmationToken.description: Token from a confirmation_required response. Confirms its saved refund before expiresAt.
confirmationToken.title: minLength(1)

details.description: Private explanation required only when reason is other. Maximum 500 characters.
details.title: maxLength(500)

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency-Key sent with the call. Omit it on the first call to get a new one; on the confirm call pass the idempotencyKey from the confirmation_required reply.
idempotencyKey.title: maxLength(200)

preview.description: true returns confirmation_required with a held confirmationToken for every refund, a full refund too. Nothing changes until it is confirmed.

reason.description: Why the owner is closing or cancelling the entire bounty.

name: cancel_bounty
title: Cancel bounty
